correctness.rationale: Conditional covariance frequencies follow from bounded martingale-difference strong laws for all fixed renewal lags and an integrable exponential collision-tail envelope. Borel–Cantelli yields eventual O(log n) conditional dependence radius. Independent b_n=n^(1/3) blocks, gap maximal-L2 o(n), Lyapunov fourth moment O(b_n log²n/n), and uniform variance profile give a quenched triangular-array FCLT; the variance is necessarily nonnegative. The public reproducible code confirms a nonstationary concrete covariance model but not the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: A fixed observation schedule is known in practice; annealed scalar asymptotics can mask exceptional schedules and cannot yield simultaneous confidence bands. This theorem provides an almost-sure conditioned Brownian process law for nonstationary covariance-almost-periodic signals even when the sampled sequence need not be stationary or uniformly mixing; a periodic Brownian-sign example gives an explicit conditional variance.
